k: The Stormcrown's eye. For three hundred years Skyreach's Lantern held it down beneath the isle. The Lantern went dark, and the storm remembered it was alive.
src: 'The Stormcrown\'s eye. For three hundred years Skyreach\'s Lantern held it down beneath the isle. The Lantern went dark, and the storm remembered it was alive.'

k: Mawmire sinks into the black water. The bog itself seems to harden around it.
src: 'Mawmire sinks into the black water. The bog itself seems to harden around it.'

k: Mawmire's flank splits like rotten fruit. Something small and wet climbs out.
src: 'Mawmire\'s flank splits like rotten fruit. Something small and wet climbs out.'

k: Mawmire drinks the bog. Its belly swells black. _Brace!_
src: 'Mawmire drinks the bog. Its belly swells black. _Brace!_'

k: The Warden does not see you. It sees only the dark it has been fighting for a year.
src: 'The Warden does not see you. It sees only the dark it has been fighting for a year.'

k: Hollowbark drives its roots into the earth. Briars claw up out of the soil!
src: 'Hollowbark drives its roots into the earth. Briars claw up out of the soil!'

k: Hollowbark drinks from the deep roots. Old sap closes its wounds.
src: 'Hollowbark drinks from the deep roots. Old sap closes its wounds.'

k: Hollowbark's bark splits open, bristling with thorns as long as swords...
src: 'Hollowbark\'s bark splits open, bristling with thorns as long as swords...'

k: "Sunspears! Shields together!"
src: '"Sunspears! Shields together!"'

k: "Remember this, Kestrel? Stand still. You're good at that."
src: '"Remember this, Kestrel? Stand still. You\'re good at that."'

k: Corder levels his lance...
src: 'Corder levels his lance...'

k: "Hold the line! For the Lord-Commander!"
src: '"Hold the line! For the Lord-Commander!"'

k: The Thunderhead tears loose pieces of itself. They crackle into shape.
src: 'The Thunderhead tears loose pieces of itself. They crackle into shape.'

k: The clouds peel back. At the heart of the storm, an eye opens — and looks at you.
src: 'The clouds peel back. At the heart of the storm, an eye opens — and looks at you.'

k: The wind falls silent. Your ears pop. The pressure is dropping...
src: 'The wind falls silent. Your ears pop. The pressure is dropping...'

src: 'Fern\'s Forage & Fletching'

src: 'A stilt village over the fens. Mother Osk keeps its Lantern — kept it.'

src: 'The oldest forest in Solmere, and Rootholm at its edge. Elowen, the oldest Keeper, lives at its heart.'

src: 'The rain-lashed foot of the Stormcrown, where the Halcyon waits on her cradle.'

src: 'Duskwater Jelly'

src: '"...help us... it\'s so cold... help..." Hands claw up out of the water.'

src: 'It calls again, in voices you almost know.'

src: 'The Tidemourner draws in a long, wet, rattling breath...'
